shared_elements: repeated small signs or symbols arranged in horizontal rows
geometric motifs including circles/discs and short linear marks
animal forms shown schematically in profile
justification: The strongest shared content is the presence of schematic profile birds/animals and rows of repeated small signs or motifs. The major difference is that A is dominated by a few large, isolated animal figures and decorative bands, while B is dominated by dense horizontal writing-like registers with small signs and framed seated human figures.
